# Copyleaks

Copyleaks provides plagiarism, AI content, image, video, moderation, and writing analysis APIs.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/copyleaks/.

## Actions

- **Check Writing**: Return grammar, mechanics, structure, word-choice, and readability feedback synchronously.
- **Detect AI Text**: Classify text as human- or AI-written synchronously.
- **Get AI Text Credit Balance** (read-only): Return the connected account's separate AI Text Detector wallet balance.
- **Get Credit Balance** (read-only): Return the connected Copyleaks account's general plagiarism and authenticity scan credit balance.
- **Get Supported Metadata** (read-only): Return one public Copyleaks capability catalog.
- **Moderate Text**: Detect harmful-content labels in text synchronously.
